info.title: Turnstile organization configuration and onboarding
info.description: ONB-RD02 supplies executable v1/v2 setup contracts and exact Kolkata/Calcutta/UTC support. ONB-RD03 implements v2 initialization, incomplete-only v1 upgrade, canonical readiness, first-unit activation and completed-v2 last-unit deletion protection. Completed v1 preserves version/revision/completion and optional-unit policy. ONB-RD04 implements the guarded, revision-checked parent-change handler and atomic move audit. ONB-RD05 implements dedicated resumable Organization/First unit/Review and ordinary waiting layouts. ONB-RD06 consumes parent changes in a shared visual editor with confirmed Move to/pointer/touch paths and explicit readback. ONB-RD07 supplies persistent responsive completed navigation and canonical ongoing Settings. ONB-RD08 verifies exact packaged migrations/contracts, version-aware archive preservation and the selected local release. Ship compatible migrations/API/web together after full verification; source implementation is not target rollout and old strict clients cannot be assumed to parse v2. Production acceptance is deployment-specific. Same-origin BFF; credentials stay server-side. Generated from shared Zod contracts; JSON Schema records structural rules and descriptions record executable normalization/cross-field rules. See architecture.md for limits, authorization and upgrade sequencing.

x-setup-policy.description: RD03 initializes v2 after the owning migrations and upgrades only incomplete v1 without changing business revision, saved data or zone. Completed v1 preserves version/revision/completion and optional-unit policy; completed v2 protects its final qualifying direct child. Time-zone-list provenance is independent of setup requirement version.

x-workspace-business-gate.description: ONB-I04 enforces: otherwise permitted business operations, including /api/dms/capabilities, require completed setup. Explicit route permissions precede readiness. Auth/session/logout/health retain their established boundaries. Optional feature outages never undo completion.

post.summary: Atomically activate or read back the completed workspace
post.description: Requires current turnstile:access and turnstile:configuration:manage; never grants account, access, DMS operator or approval authority. Readiness-exempt only; authentication, local access, route permissions and mutation CSRF remain enforced. No query parameters or caller-supplied tenant/application/actor selectors. Validate persisted name, confirmed zone, root and current manager at one revision; v2 additionally requires a saved direct-child Site or Department, otherwise 400 CONFIGURATION_INVALID with body/required. Completed v1 remains valid without first_unit. Concurrent or lost-response repeats return the same completion actor/time/version after current authorization; a syntactically valid stale expectedRevision is ignored only after completion. One lifecycle audit outcome. No DMS HTTP call or automatic activation.

All versions retain leaf/reference and root-identity protection.

patch.summary: Move a non-root subtree to a saved parent at the current revision
patch.description: Requires current turnstile:access and turnstile:configuration:manage; never grants account, access, DMS operator or approval authority. Readiness-exempt only; authentication, local access, route permissions and mutation CSRF remain enforced. No query parameters or caller-supplied tenant/application/actor selectors. Lock canonical configuration and recheck live permissions/revision before source/destination validation. Reject missing units (404), root moves (id/unsupported), self/descendant/type relationships (parentId/invalid), subtree depth (parentId/limit_reached), duplicate siblings, implemented reference refusals (409 unit_in_use) and last-required-unit removal (409 required_unit). Existing root/parent references, create receipts, IDs/types, descendant links, completion and grants survive valid moves. Effective moves commit one revision and unit_moved audit atomically; same-parent/current-revision requests are no-ops. Canonical readback after lost responses precedes any explicit retry; no automatic write replay. The sole direct child cannot move below another node without creating a cycle under the current rooted model; the explicit v2 required-unit guard is retained as a backstop.
patch.x-implementation-status: implemented in ONB-RD04 with live manage/CSRF checks, guarded parent-column privileges, canonical subtree validation and atomic move audit/revision; readiness-exempt

get.description: Requires a current customer session and turnstile:access. Available before workspace or deployment approval. Returns derived state only, with private/no-store caching; no registry binding, signed token, key, user grant mutation or central network call. Retry re-reads the owning verified decision; it does not pair or approve the product.

TimeZone.description: Exact shared time-zone allowlist, including Asia/Kolkata, retained Asia/Calcutta and UTC. List provenance is independent of setup requirement version. An explicitly submitted value confirms the zone; no browser/OS default or numeric offset is accepted.

UnitMove.description: Move a non-root unit to a saved parent. Backend validation checks current authorization/revision, relationships, cycles, full subtree depth, sibling names, references and required-unit preservation. Same-parent/current-revision is a no-op. Reconcile an uncertain response through canonical readback before explicit retry; never automatically replay.

UnitCreateHeaders.description: Only the projected Idempotency-Key header; transport and CSRF headers are validated separately by the HTTP boundary.

Setup.description: Versioned setup: v1 retains its four requirements and valid root-only completion. V2 adds first_unit before configuration_manager; Review additionally requires a saved direct-child Site/Department. Resume Organization for profile/root gaps, Structure for a v2 first-unit gap, otherwise Review. Not-started is revision 0 with no saved business values; saved/completed revisions are positive. Completion matches the setup version and requires every check. Cross-field rules are enforced by executable validation.
